item.title: My chess program post mortem
item.description:
Ok, I would be lying if I said that this is my first-ever program written in C++. But I will be counting this one as first.

So what is this program about? I wanted to make a simple chess game so I can learn C++. Of course, at the beginning, I overestimated my knowledge. But let’s start from the start.

What I wanted to do Link to heading

Initially, I wanted to create a fully working chess game in the terminal. The user would be using official chess notation to make moves. The game would be playable against the computer or as multiplayer.
